entries.title: When refund eligibility is constrained by the booking.
entries.lesson: When refund eligibility is constrained by the booking record (e.g., no insurance, basic economy, >24 hours, no airline cancellation), clearly state limitations, avoid committing to exceptions, and offer a human-agent transfer for.
